items.title: Mark Soskin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 17, 2021
items.q: that was the first record that I did with Sonny and that was with Tony Williams and Donald Byrd.

ctx.x: He had to have calypso music, because we always did calypsos. I mean that was kind of our theme song was “Don’t Stop the Carnival” from the record “Don’t Stop the Carni —” that was the first record that I did with Sonny and that was with Tony Williams and Donald Byrd. And so, it’s important.
Well let’s talk about your composing a little bit. Where do your ideas come from?
